title: Terrain, Objectives, Zones, Sieges & Strategic Position
objective: Implement visibility-first deterministic projection of explicit terrain, zone, objective, siege-context and strategic-position evidence plus read-only owner-domain effect/handoff references, preserving canonical World/location, Combat/Action/Event, Asset, Organization and Permission/visibility authority.

scenario_rules.defense: terrain such as asteroid fields may enhance evasion

authority_rules: Source terrain rules are visible read-only effect references and handoffs; SCL-07 does not mutate speed, stealth, evasion, collision, damage, morale, retreat or World state.
Scenario victory conditions may be represented only as explicit objective references; SCL-07 never auto-completes or adjudicates them.
Siege and strategic-position records may carry explicit owner-backed evidence but unresolved mechanics remain unknown; no universal siege clock or strategic advantage is invented.
World/location, Combat/Action/Event, Asset, Organization and Permission/visibility owners remain canonical.

Visibility filters before record inclusion, counts, state, effects, objectives, summaries, search, provenance, handoffs, deterministic receipt or AI context; hidden existence/cardinality is undisclosed.
Missing, unknown, conflict and incompatible evidence remains conservative and is never auto-reconciled.
Stable record-ID ordering governs deterministic projections and receipts; ordering never creates priority or authority.
No owner mutation, autonomous AI command/adjudication, duplicate terrain/objective ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-08 retains vehicle/mecha/ship/fleet integration; SCL-09 retains casualty/damage/recovery; SCL-10 retains faction/settlement/world/campaign consequences.

validation_requirements: Acceptance-first current-family SCL-07 test/proof/profile/verifier must establish genuine matching Linux/Windows RED before production surfaces exist.
Final exact-head Validation Core must run exactly one SCL-07 profile on self-hosted Linux and Windows and deterministic comparison with historical predecessor profile fanout zero.
Accessible nonvisual panel and deterministic stable ordering are required.

convergence_control.retry_basis: Owner Continue governed-started SCL-07 from exact pinned AIOC and application baselines after one bounded source/authority recovery pass.

next_action: After exact-head AIOC Repository Health passes and this governed-start authority merges, create the SCL-07 application branch at exact baseline 92821565cfc0035059c15808c265411b4d419157 and establish genuine acceptance-first RED before production mutation.
